name: The AMB 3-Piece Formula
subject: A 3-piece rule for better outfits (and fewer random buys)
preheader: Use this simple styling formula before you buy another piece.
headline: Before you buy another piece, ask one question: can it build three outfits?
intro: Here is the AMB rule: choose one strong anchor, add one layer that changes the proportion, then finish with one accessory that makes the look feel intentional. It is a simple way to get more outfits from fewer pieces — and a better filter for what deserves a place in your wardrobe.
heroAlt: Sabine Tailored Romper from the AMB BOUTIQUE 3-Piece Formula edit
productSectionTitle: Start with the anchor. Add the layer. Finish with intention.
closingTitle: Can you name three ways you would wear it before you click add to bag?
closingBody: If the answer is yes, the piece is already doing more work for you. Think weekday, weekend and evening. Change one layer, one shoe or one bag and the same anchor becomes a different outfit. Buy with a plan, then style it your way.
